links.comparator_used: Single fixed decision threshold of 0.5 applied to all rhythm labels
links.outcome: Mean specificity and macro-F1 across 15 rhythm labels
links.effect: Mean specificity rose from 0.844 (0.822–0.865) to 0.885 (0.860–0.909); macro-F1 fell from 0.738 (0.666–0.774) at fixed 0.5 threshold to 0.693 (0.628–0.726)
links.tradeoff: Overall macro-F1 was lower with clinically oriented thresholds, so higher specificity came at the cost of overall F1 balance.
links.quote: Clinically oriented thresholds increased mean specificity from 0.844 (0.822–0.865) to 0.885 (0.860–0.909), but reduced macro-F1 to 0.693 (0.628–0.726).
